source: Pin every source, engine and patch
Map source and build recipe to immutable release digest
code: Review license compatibility and corresponding-source obligations
Keep platform MIT terms separate from title terms
dependencies: Inventory runtime, build, vendored and remotely loaded dependencies
Produce dependency inventory and reproducible build evidence
assets: Map every image, font, sound, level and generated asset to origin and terms
Record modifications, attribution and redistribution evidence
AI-generated content requires provenance and review too
brand: Review title, logos, screenshots and attribution wording
privacy: Inventory network endpoints, trackers, ads and telemetry
Review guest local saves, optional account-linked sync, migration and deletion
Keep account credentials and attribution identifiers in host-owned services
Record retention, consent and marketing attribution data flows
safety: Review content, age suitability and launch regions
Review online features and abuse surfaces
Exclude commercial Doom data; FreeDM requires reviewed local or bot play
technical: Verify guest play plus complete controller and touch flows
Record capabilities, WebGPU fallback and target WebView evidence
Verify lifecycle, isolation and host-owned save boundaries
Test native input transport only through a bounded replaceable provider
operations: Record accountable maintainer and release owner
Verify notices and corresponding source for exact release
Document monitoring, withdrawal, rollback and emergency response
Record update and policy re-review triggers

note: Evidence completeness checks do not authenticate reviewers or provide legal clearance, host permissions, or publication authorization.
